role: Previously inspected eight-source integration regression after versioned public draw/grant/intent/act-prefix changes

gates.full_completion: Exactly two outcomes per nonempty candidate action, all true terminal and settlement-complete, nonutility target completeness masks valid, and two accepted posterior worlds; costs alone do not establish settlement completion
gates.zero_error_scope: Source attempts, proposal engine or cleanup audit, and every continuation branch
gates.map_reconstruction_executed: Eligible complete-map root with exact new-law/support/profile IDs; each accepted proposal reconstructed once with zero initial Map cells
gates.decision_index_positive_means: An observed local decision after the first; does not imply more than one candidate action.

selection_accounting: All 8 predetermined source draws remain denominator, including absent, failed, timed out, or unexecuted. No replacement draws or success quota. Selected combat and local-decision indices are fixed by the declared source prior before execution.
time_bias: Deadline truncation is unresolved computational mass. Completed-by-deadline rows do not establish unbiased admission.
comparison: Same public inputs, prior, source draws, final evaluation seeds, order and budgets as Map v4; already inspected.
run_precondition: Independent component reviews and full frozen Worker/Core regressions pass. Freeze source and binaries; no concurrent builds or timed experiments. Python source is unchanged or guarded relevant checks pass.
gate_use: The original throughput criteria are retained only for direct integration comparison. A later independent predeclared cohort is required before breadth claims; no production admission from this diagnostic.
additional_descriptive_counts: fully complete roots with at least two candidates
fully complete later-combat roots with at least two candidates
paired_evaluation_seed_note: Fixed within-root world seeds are reused across roots and implementations for this development comparison; accepted slots are not a claim of globally independent samples.
